description: This file contains shell script code for testing Git operations related to cherry-picking with the --ff option. It sets up test environments, performs cherry-pick operations, and verifies expected behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Sets up the object ID cache with specified values.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares revisions to verify they are the same.
